In Guangxu year 32, bingwu, in the ninth month on yimao, the ministries of Foreign Affairs, Personnel, Civil Administration, Finance, Rites, Education, Army, Law, Agriculture-Industry-Commerce, Posts and Communications, and Colonial Affairs were established, each with one minister and two vice ministers. The Censorate was given one censor-in-chief and two deputy censors-in-chief. None of these posts was divided into Manchu and Han seats. The Boards of Revenue, War, and Punishments were renamed, and the Board of Works was abolished.Minister in Charge of Foreign Affairs.Joint Minister of Foreign Affairs.Minister of Foreign Affairs.Minister of Civil Affairs.Minister of Finance.Minister of Rites.學部尚書.陸軍部尚書.Minister of Law.Minister of Agriculture, Industry, and Commerce.Minister of Posts and Communications.理藩部尚書.Censor-in-Chief of the Censorate.Left Vice Minister of Foreign Affairs.Right Vice Minister of Foreign Affairs.Left Vice Minister of Personnel.Right Vice Minister of Personnel.Left Vice Minister of Civil Affairs.Right Vice Minister of Civil Affairs.度支部左侍郎.Right Vice Minister of Finance.Left Vice Minister of Rites.Right Vice Minister of Rites.Left Vice Minister of Education.Right Vice Minister of Education.陸軍部左侍郎.Right Vice Minister of the Army.法部左侍郎.法部右侍郎.Left Vice Minister of Agriculture, Industry, and Commerce.Right Vice Minister of Agriculture, Industry, and Commerce.Left Vice Minister of Posts and Communications.Right Vice Minister of Posts and Communications.理藩部左侍郎.理藩部右侍郎.都察院副都御史.都察院副都御史.
